capabilities: Highlight selected text with colours in Reading view and PDFs
Tag highlights and attach footnote annotations to them
Review highlights in a note navigator and a vault-wide research view
Export highlights to Markdown, JSON, CSV or Canvas
Resume reading from a saved scroll position
extras: Highlight colours require Obsidian 1.14 or later; the plugin states it makes no network requests and keeps all data as plain Markdown. Development is hosted via the BRAT beta channel (DuckTapeKiller/obsidian-reader-highlighter-tags), and the settings mention Ko-fi support.
intentEvidence: This plugin writes exactly that, so your highlights stay plain text
problem: Obsidian's highlighting requires Edit or Live Preview mode and colored highlights default to HTML, so highlighting while reading means leaving Reading view and polluting notes with markup.

relations.evidence: With BRAT. Install BRAT, choose Add beta plugin

summary: Reading-view highlighting tool that adds colored Markdown highlights, tags, footnote annotations, navigation, a vault-wide research view, and exports.
